speed-desc: RetroFeVLC delivers unmatched performance. It scrolls from game #1 to game #2350 in only 1 minute — pure speed without compromises. No other frontend comes close.
bento-whatis-p1: Forget the limitations of old frameworks. RetroFeVLC is a true next-generation evolution that replaces GStreamer with the powerful VLC Media Library. This delivers flawless 4K Pre-Scale rendering and a rock-solid, leak-free architecture built for arcade stability.
bento-whatis-p2: Whether you have 500 or 50,000+ games, enjoy ultra-smooth navigation and superior video playback that transforms your collection into a premium cinematic experience.
bento-start-p1: Stop struggling with text files. Our custom Start.exe serves as the central brain, giving you a clean, powerful GUI to control your entire setup instantly.
bento-list-2: Marquee Mastery: Native support for secondary monitors.
bento-list-3: Kiosk Mode: Transform Windows into a dedicated console.
bento-list-4: Ultra-Fast Search: Find any game instantly by title, system or genre via controller.
bento-speed-p: Push boundaries with 3D Effects & Warp perspective. Thanks to Per-Game Layouts, every title can have its own unique, handcrafted visual identity.
bento-rank-p: Ranked among the top 5 retro gaming frontends in 2026. RetroFeVLC delivers lightweight performance with premium features and complete creative freedom — without the bloat.
bento-jukebox-p: RetroFeVLC can also be used as a complete Jukebox. Save custom lists, recall them instantly, control volume, enable repeat, repeat track and shuffle. Create up to 32 individual lists per collection.
bento-sort-p: Organize your view instantly by clicking. Sort by Year, Manufacturer, Genre, Metadata and more — no menus, no configuration files needed.
bento-meta-p: New metadata fields: Artist, Album, Track Number and Disc Number. Perfect for music and multi-disc collections.
bento-layout-p: Automatic text resizing, multi-grid support, independent configuration per display, and background layer (layer 20) when launching smaller windows. Animations on secondary displays when no primary is active.
upd-5: New Grid menu option & include files

guide-desc: RetroFeVLC Comprehensive User Guide — 35 pages. Complete manual covering Quick Start, Directory Structure, Settings & Controls Editors, Collections, Launchers, Metadata, Addons and all advanced features.
wiki-card-desc: Comprehensive online documentation, XML layout tutorial, configuration guides, architecture deep-dive, and troubleshooting steps.
forum-card-desc: Connect with fellow retro gamers! Ask questions, share custom layouts & themes, post feature requests, and get official support.
video-desc: Watch the complete step-by-step setup walkthrough and explore the interface in action.
addons-subtitle: Powerful tools that work together to make RetroFeVLC faster, smarter, and easier to use.
ad-start:
🚀 Start.exe (Starter)
The brain of the system. Auto-launches everything, syncs playlists, manages gamepads, and provides a powerful system tray menu.
ad-search:
🔍 Search (F11)
Lightning-fast search by title, system or game genre across your full library. Fully gamepad friendly.
ad-menumanager:
📋 MenuManager
Visual drag-and-drop menu editor. Create, reorder and organize categories easily.
ad-metadata:
🔄 Metadata ReGenerator
Creates optimized smaller hyperlists and shows accurate game counts.
ad-genrefixer:
🎨 GenreFixer
AI-powered automatic genre correction across your collection.
ad-kioskmode:
🛡️ KioskMode
Locks Windows into a dedicated console with auto-relaunch and password protection.
ad-story:
🌐 Story Translator
AI translation of game stories into multiple languages.
ad-layouteditor:
🖌️ Layout Editor
Visual theme editor with real-time graphical preview, making it easy to design, preview, and adjust layouts without launching RetroFeVLC.
ad-retroRa:
🏆 RetroRa Sync
Syncs RetroAchievements progress into your frontend for beautiful stats.
ad-marquee:
🖼️ Marquee MonitorDuplicator
Mirrors gameplay to your marquee monitor with full control.
comparison-subtitle: RetroFeVLC offers modern features and enhanced usability while maintaining full flexibility — ideal for users who want power without legacy complexity.

ad-skraper:
🖼️ RetroFeVLCSkraper
Comprehensive artwork scraper integrating ScreenScraper.fr, SteamGridDB, EmuMovies, TheGamesDB, IGDB & Libretro CDN. Fast multi-source downloads for covers, marquees, wheels & metadata.
addons-multilang: Native Multi-Language Support: EN, PT, ES, FR, IT, DE, GR, RU, ZH across all addons
ad-diagramtree:
🌳 Layout Diagram Tree
Diagnostic and compilation tool that maps modular XML theme dependencies (), tracks variable overrides, and consolidates all XML files into an optimized temp.xml.
